text.en: Customers frequently praise this self-service dog wash on Cass Street in Pacific Beach for its clean, orderly facilities and ample parking. Reviewers appreciate that the automated washing bays are simple to operate, offering warm water, pet products through the hose, and no waiting queues during routine visits.

Pet parents highlight that the calm atmosphere helps dogs relax far more than traditional noisy bathing salons. While one reviewer suggested bringing a towel for dogs sensitive to dryer noise, customers appreciate thoughtful extras like vending machine dog ice cream and warm wash water that pets enjoy.

Reviewers report that dogs leave feeling soft, clean, and smelling great following quick washes. The integrated flea shampoo and conditioning rinses receive positive remarks, with owners noting that 15-minute cycles provide sufficient time to wash and dry medium and small pets thoroughly.

q.en: Are appointments required to wash dogs at this location?

a.en: No, the facility is completely self-serve with automated wash stations, and customers can walk in anytime without advance booking.

q.en: What amenities are provided in the wash stations?

a.en: Tubs feature warm water, integrated shampoo, conditioner, flea wash, and blow dryers, along with on-site treat vending machines.

q.en: How long does a standard wash cycle take?

a.en: Reviewers indicate that standard 15-minute cycles provide enough time for washing, with optional additional time for drying.

q.en: Is customer assistance available if equipment malfunctions?

a.en: Yes, clients report that the owners are highly responsive by text message and resolve occasional equipment questions promptly.
